items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Like the motorist called me Connie.

ctx.x: He had the orchestra at Tranchinas, which was competitive to mine, and also the halfway house. There was Tranchinas, the halfway house where the Brunus boys played, and Carl's. And we've got all the business. So there's a lot of people that are traditionals here in New Orleans that I never heard play. I offered a reward to hear a certain, anybody could ever find, find anybody that heard a certain trumpet player but never did find him. But still he's supposed to be great. Where did he play? Where was I when he was…
I guess some of those trumpet players went to Chicago very young or something.
